sources.title: On almost commuting matrices with respect to the normalized Hilbert-Schmidt norm
sources.interface: Fixed pairs or fixed finite tuples of selfadjoint contractions in normalized Hilbert-Schmidt norm.
sources.mismatch: Tuple size dependence; pair corrections depend on both inputs; no channel, complete image, or EB map conclusion.

sources.title: A Note on Approximate Liftings
sources.authors: Don Hadwin and Stuart W. Shulman
sources.interface: Fixed finite number of almost commuting elements; countably generated commutative algebra lifted into diffuse finite von Neumann algebras.
sources.mismatch: No uniformity over growing range generators; finite matrix coordinates are not diffuse; lifts *-homomorphisms rather than the channel in induced norm.

sources.title: On ultrapowers of non-commutative L_p spaces
sources.interface: Isometric identification of ultraproducts of Haagerup L_p spaces with L_p of the von Neumann ultraproduct.
sources.mismatch: L_p identification is not a CP-map lifting or EB-rounding theorem.

sources.title: Quantum de Finetti Theorems under Local Measurements with Applications
sources.authors: Fernando G. S. L. Brandao and Aram W. Harrow
sources.interface: k-extendible states and local-measurement norms with prescribed optimization order.
sources.mismatch: No full trace-norm map approximation on every operator contraction.

sources.title: Fixed points in de Finetti hierarchies
sources.authors: Gereon Kossmann and Julius A. Zeiss
sources.interface: Exactly constrained one-sided permutation-invariant state extensions; constrained separable approximation.
sources.mismatch: Extension/state theorem with fixed-point block parameters, not uniform CP-map lifting.

sources.title: Almost commuting matrices and stability for product groups
sources.interface: Non-normal contraction/group-representation stability in normalized Hilbert-Schmidt norm.
sources.mismatch: Not a CP image or selfcompatible channel; used only to delimit generic tuple claims.

scope_note: Targeted primary-source pass, not exhaustive literature or novelty review.
